title: DePhaseKit: A toolkit for depth-phase precursor picking and crustal-thickness inversion
description:
DePhaseKit (深度震相分析工具包) is a desktop GUI and computation library for analysing source-side depth phases in teleseismic waveforms.

It supports interactive arrival-time picking on SAC data, grouping and stacking records by epicentral distance and azimuth, picking the depth-phase precursors pmP and smP on stacked traces, and inverting crustal thickness at the reflection point from the pP-pmP differential travel time. Two mutually independent forward paths are provided and cross-validated: a flat-layer analytic formula and exact ray tracing through spherically symmetric models with a variable Moho depth built for TauP. A cross-event review tool collects pierce points and thicknesses so that anomalous groups can be located quickly.

The package accompanies a study of crustal thickness beneath the South Sandwich island arc, an intra-oceanic subduction zone that lies almost entirely below sea level and therefore cannot be imaged by receiver functions or ambient-noise methods. Because the reflection point lies above the source rather than beneath a station, the method requires no stations in the study area.
